projects.title: Nebula Study - AI Learning Platform
projects.description: A comprehensive AI-powered educational platform featuring 7 specialized tools to enhance learning efficiency. It includes AI-generated flashcards with spaced repetition, step-by-step problem solvers, automated exam practice, and AI-driven summarization for students and professionals.
highlights: AI-powered ecosystem with 7 specialized learning modules
Spaced Repetition algorithm for personalized Flashcard retention
Interactive step-by-step problem solving solutions via Gemini AI
Real-time collaboration and study chat using Socket.io
Automated PDF analysis and smart summarization tools
Scalable architecture with Next.js and PostgreSQL

projects.title: Badminton Shop E-commerce
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce platform specialized in badminton equipment with AI-powered shopping assistant,secure payment processing, and comprehensive admin dashboard for managing products and orders.
highlights: AI-powered shopping assistant using Google Generative AI for product recommendations
Secure authentication system with JWT and email verification
Real-time inventory management with PostgreSQL and Sequelize ORM
Responsive UI with Tailwind CSS and modern glassmorphism design
Integrated payment processing with Stripe and multiple payment methods
Multi-language support with i18next internationalization
Admin dashboard for product, order, and user management
Advanced product filtering, searching, and wishlist functionality
Customer reviews and ratings system with feedback management
Performance optimized with Redis caching and image lazy loading

projects.title: Hospital Management System (HMS)
projects.description: A comprehensive, full-stack hospital management solution designed to streamline healthcare operations. It features a robust role-based access control system (RBAC), patient and doctor management, appointment scheduling, medical records, billing, and real-time updates for efficient hospital internal workflows.
highlights: Production-ready internal hospital management system
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Admin, Doctor, Nurse, and staff
Comprehensive management of Patients, Appointments, and Medical Records
Automated billing system and medicine inventory tracking
Real-time notifications and system updates using Socket.io
Modern UI/UX built with Next.js 14 and Tailwind CSS

projects.title: Contract Management System
projects.description: A full-stack enterprise contract management platform with automated workflows, role-based permissions, document generation, and real-time analytics built with Laravel and Filament.
highlights: Advanced role-based access control with 6 roles and 15 granular permission features
Automated multi-stage workflow with 6 contract statuses and intelligent notifications
Dynamic Word document generation with Vietnamese text support and custom templates
Real-time analytics dashboard tracking contract values, payments, and expiration dates
Comprehensive financial management with automated payment and liquidation tracking
Multi-party contract handling with customizable terms, products, and legal clauses
Intelligent supervisor assignment system based on contract types and roles
Secure authentication with database sessions and CloudFlare proxy integration
Professional admin interface built with Filament 3 featuring dark mode design
Advanced filtering, search, and export capabilities for all contract data

projects.title: Car Repair Management System
projects.description: A comprehensive full-stack car repair management platform with real-time appointment booking, service tracking, and customer management system for automotive repair shops.
highlights: Real-time appointment booking and status tracking system
Comprehensive dashboard for repair history and invoicing
Push notifications for repair status updates
Mobile app for technicians using React Native
Role-based access control for customers, technicians, and admins
Integrated rewards and loyalty program
Email and SMS notification services
Advanced search and filtering for services and appointments

projects.title: TikTok Clone
projects.description: A full-stack short video sharing platform with WebRTC livestream, real-time messaging, intelligent recommendation system, and complete social media interaction features.
highlights: Real-time livestream with WebRTC and P2P connection management
Direct messaging system with real-time notifications via Laravel Echo
Smart video recommendation algorithm based on engagement and watch history
Automatic video upload and thumbnail generation with FFmpeg
Complete interaction features: like, comment, share, favorite, follow

projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: A beautiful and responsive weather application with real-time weather data, modern glass morphism design, and intuitive user interface for checking weather conditions worldwide.
highlights: Modern glass morphism UI design with animated backgrounds
Real-time weather data integration with OpenWeatherMap API
Responsive design optimized for all devices
TypeScript for better code quality and development experience
Smooth animations and hover effects for enhanced UX

projects.title: Minimal Zen - Todo App
projects.description: A mindful task management app built with React, featuring Japanese Minimalism and Neumorphism design philosophy for peaceful and conscious productivity.
highlights: Minimal Zen design with Japanese Neumorphism aesthetics
Animated SVG checkbox with stroke-dasharray drawing effect
Completed tasks display with blur effect instead of strikethrough
Floating Action Button (FAB) with rotation animation
Modal with backdrop blur and smooth scale-in transitions
Soft neumorphic shadows (inset + outset) on all elements
Animated gradient background shift (15s loop)
Custom scrollbar with gradient and rounded design
Nunito light-weight font (300-400) for gentle aesthetics
Pastel color palette: Sage green, Warm beige, Soft coral
Responsive design with generous spacing (40px+)
LocalStorage persistence - no data loss on refresh

projects.title: TaskFlow Pro - Kanban Board
projects.description: A modern Kanban project management app built with React, featuring glassmorphism design, smooth drag & drop, dark/light mode, and beautiful animation effects.
highlights: Drag & drop tasks between columns with 3D animations
Dark/Light mode with gradient backgrounds and particles
Glassmorphism design with backdrop-blur effects
Task management with priority, tags, and descriptions
LocalStorage persistence – no data loss on refresh
Advanced animations powered by Framer Motion
Fully responsive for mobile and desktop devices
Floating action buttons with micro-interactions

projects.title: High-Performance API Service
projects.description: A robust backend system built with FastAPI and Redis, featuring distributed task queues, real-time analytics, and optimized database performance for high-traffic applications.
highlights: Scalable microservices architecture with FastAPI
Asynchronous task processing using Celery and RabbitMQ
Real-time data caching and session management with Redis
Advanced performance monitoring and logging system
Automated API documentation with Swagger/OpenAPI
